## Active-play share (#46)

Active-play share is `(flagship unloads + contract rewards) / all income`, all income being flagship + drones + contracts. Contract rewards count as active play because the player earns them by mining, breaking and delivering. Target: **≥ 40% through the mid-game** (systems 3–6).

- Mid-game pooled (income-weighted, 40 seed-warps): **60%** (flagship 46% · drones 40% · contracts 15%) — **PASS**
- Mid-game across seed-warps: median 62%, 38%–79%
- Per system (median, min–max): 3: 66% (38%–79%) · 4: 63% (53%–79%) · 5: 60% (49%–79%) · 6: 62% (50%–70%)
